_note: SigNoz ingests the quality_delta histogram DECOMPOSED (.sum/.count/.bucket/.min/.max); there is no single 'trusttrace.quality_delta' metric to average. Build the average in the UI as a formula A/B where A=rate(trusttrace.quality_delta.sum), B=rate(trusttrace.quality_delta.count), and alert on A/B < -0.10. See docs/observability.md 'Querying the histogram metrics in SigNoz'. The query block below records the INTENT (avg quality_delta).
description: Fires when the fine-tuned path's schema-validity drops more than 10 percentage points below the base path's, i.e. avg(trusttrace.quality_delta) over 5m falls below -0.10. Healthy traffic sits near +0.86. (PRD §11.4)

annotations.description: avg(trusttrace.quality_delta) over 5m < -0.10 — the fine-tuned path is failing schema validity relative to base. Investigate / roll back the adapter.
